components.css: :host{--tyvek:#eceef1;--sheet:#ffffff;--ink:#111214;--mute:#5b5e66;--rule:#d2d5db;--pin:#b8bcc4;--ultra:#2436d6;--ultra-deep:#1a2aa8;--ultra-wash:#e4e7fb;--on-ultra:#ffffff;--on-ultra-mute:#d3d8ff;--font:'Archivo','Arial Narrow',sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);} .ds-pin{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;background:var(--tyvek);border:2px solid var(--pin);} .ds-week{display:flex;gap:14px;padding:8px 0 12px;background:var(--tyvek);} .ds-wb{position:relative;width:120px;height:124px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;padding:10px 14px 12px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;background:var(--sheet);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:0;color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font);transition:transform 200ms var(--ease-out);box-sizing:border-box;} .ds-wb:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);} .ds-wb:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ultra);outline-offset:2px;} .ds-wb .ds-pin{width:7px;height:7px;border-width:1.5px;top:5px;box-sizing:border-box;} .ds-pin.l{left:5px;} .ds-pin.r{right:5px;} .ds-wd,.ds-ws{font-family:var(--font);font-stretch:75%;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.08em;text-transform:uppercase;} .ds-wd{font-size:13px;} .ds-ws{font-size:12px;color:var(--mute);letter-spacing:0.04em;} .ds-wn{font-stretch:62%;font-weight:900;font-size:52px;line-height:0.9;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-prof{width:100%;height:22px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linejoin:round;} .is-ride .ds-wn{margin-bottom:-6px;} .is-today{background:var(--ultra);border-color:var(--ultra);color:var(--on-ultra);} .is-today .ds-ws{color:var(--on-ultra-mute);} .is-sel{background:var(--ink);color:var(--sheet);box-shadow:0 6px 0 -2px var(--tyvek),0 8px 0 -2px var(--ink);} .is-sel .ds-ws{color:var(--pin);} .is-today .ds-pin,.is-sel .ds-pin{background:transparent;border-color:currentColor;opacity:0.6;} .is-rest{border-style:dashed;background:transparent;color:var(--mute);}

narrative.overview:
The week is a stage race. Each training day is a numbered stage: a white Tyvek bib pinned to an off-white ground, with its start list printed beside it like a road book. The strip of seven same-scale bibs shows the race's rhythm, alternating strength stages and trail rides with a dashed rest day, before a single caption is read.

The world is printed and flat. Race-black ink does the work; one ultramarine marks today and the primary action. A single condensed grotesk family (Archivo, driven by its width axis) carries everything at stepped sizes, from 300px bib numerals down to 11px tags, with tabular figures throughout so doses and stage numbers sit in clean columns. Paper is the only material: sheets have a hard 2px black edge and square corners, pin holes are drawn as silver rings, rows are separated by hairlines and never boxed.

Density is a road book's: generous at the top (one big bib, one big stage title), tight and columnar in the start list. Motion is a single gesture, re-pinning the bib when the stage changes.
keyCharacteristics: Tyvek ground, white bib sheets, race-black ink, one ultramarine.
One family, Archivo, at stepped sizes; width axis from 62% (numerals, titles) through 75% (labels) to 85% (doses).
Square corners everywhere; the only circles are pin holes.
Bibs are sheets with a 2px ink edge and pin holes; start-list rows are hairline-ruled, never enclosed.
Flat; depth only for the two overlays that float over the page.

rules.name: The Today Rule
rules.body: Among stage markers, ultramarine means today and nothing else. The bib band is ultramarine only when the stage shown is today; any other selected stage gets a race-black band. In the week strip today's bib is filled ultramarine, and the selected non-today bib is filled race-black. Stage selection is never shown in ultramarine.

rules.name: The One Spot Color Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine is the only chromatic color outside error states. It marks today, the primary action, focus, and change; it is never a background wash for a section or a decorative accent.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Archivo only, at stepped sizes. No second face, no in-between sizes invented per component.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Figures are tabular everywhere (set on the body), so stage numbers, doses and dates align in columns.

rules.name: The Shared Rest Rule
rules.body: When every exercise shares the rest already stated in the meta line, the per-row rest column is dropped rather than repeated.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Depth on the page is edge and fill, never shadow; shadows belong only to the drawer and save bar that overlay it.

rules.name: The Pin Rule
rules.body: Every bib carries pin holes, at every size and state.

rules.name: The Open Row Rule
rules.body: Start-list and history rows are separated by 1px hairlines and are never enclosed in boxes or cards. Bibs are the only sheets; controls (buttons, inputs) carry the 2px ink edge as instruments, not containers.

dos: **Do** reserve ultramarine for today among stage markers; show any other selected stage in race-black.
**Do** give every bib pin holes, at every size.
**Do** mark ride stages in the week strip with the same drawn trail line, a symbol, not data.
**Do** separate rows with 1px hairlines (hairline) and leave them open.
**Do** drop the per-row rest when every exercise shares the rest already stated in the meta line.
**Do** build hierarchy from Archivo's width axis and weight at the stepped sizes above, with tabular figures.
**Do** keep every corner square except pin holes.
donts: **Don't** enclose start-list or history rows in boxes or cards.
**Don't** use ultramarine to show stage selection, or as a decorative fill or section wash.
**Don't** draw the trail line from real elevation data or vary it per ride.
**Don't** add a second typeface or round any corner.
**Don't** put shadows on sheets; only the drawer and save bar float.
**Don't** use flag red for anything but errors.
